description: This file defines the BulkLeaveAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for bulk operations (approve, cancel, reject) on leave requests within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for processing bulk leave actions, transaction management, and validation rules, and it integrates with the system's leave request services.

classes.name: BulkLeaveAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for performing bulk actions (approve, cancel, reject) on leave requests. It supports transaction handling, validation, and access control, integrating with the leave request system of OrangeHRM.
